answer: Histories are stored in vertex, checked in orchard, and wander shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 10 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2769 identities would post 4162 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
